assertion.statement: The covariant rational Hodge equivalence identifies the full rational Hodge endomorphisms of the actual complex surface with its full complex algebraic endomorphisms; with the separately supplied centralizer calculation and geometric descent this yields End^0_Qbar(A)=B in the non-CM branch.
assertion.objects: The actual D210 surface A, its covariant H1(A(C),Q), rank-one left B action and right complex structure J; likewise its conjugate A_sigma.
assertion.hypotheses: A is a complex abelian surface with polarizable weight-minus-one homology. The rank-one B centralizer calculation, the non-CM choice K0=Q, and descent of complex homomorphisms to Qbar are separate retained inputs.
assertion.quantifiers: For each actual surface and every rational Hodge endomorphism; all endomorphisms, not just those preserving the chosen polarization.
assertion.parameter_range: Complex abelian varieties up to isogeny, Hodge types (-1,0),(0,-1); the current application is the non-CM D210 surface.
assertion.uniformity: No varying-field or effective uniform bound is supplied.
assertion.constants: No degree, conductor or height constant.
assertion.normalizations: Covariant H1 and Hom tensored with Q; a polarization is an existence condition on objects, not a restriction to polarization-preserving morphisms.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The imaginary-quadratic centralizer is the CM branch and is excluded here. Hodge equivalence alone supplies neither Qbar descent nor End=B without the centralizer calculation.
assertion.limit_order: First compute the rational Hodge centralizer, select the non-CM branch, then use algebraicity and the separate geometric descent.

use.reason: First compute the rational Hodge centralizer, select the non-CM branch, then use algebraicity and the separate geometric descent.

assertion.statement: For the two specified embeddings i,j of the same quadratic field F into B, inner conjugation gives b in B^times with j(x)=b^-1 i(x)b for every x in F; applied to j=f^-1 i_sigma f, the quasi-isogeny f b^-1 intertwines the specified F actions.
assertion.objects: The quaternion algebra B/Q=End^0_Qbar(A), abstract quadratic F and specified embeddings i:F→B and j=f^-1 i_sigma f:F→B.
assertion.hypotheses: B is the full non-CM endomorphism algebra; f:A→A_sigma is an independently supplied geometric quasi-isogeny, and i,i_sigma are the actual specified actions. The induced map i(x)→j(x) is a Q-algebra isomorphism of quadratic subfields.
assertion.quantifiers: For these embeddings there exists an invertible b implementing their specified field identification on every x.
assertion.parameter_range: Quadratic subfields of the characteristic-zero quaternion algebra B/Q.
assertion.uniformity: Existence for each pair only; no uniform degree or coherent choices in sigma.
assertion.normalizations: j=b^-1 i b and g=f b^-1; quasi-homomorphisms are rationalized Hom. Positive integer denominator clearing is a separate elementary step.
assertion.exceptional_cases: An unspecified conjugacy of unlabelled subfields is insufficient. b need not be integral. The official erratum corrects unit-group notation after separable extension; no inseparable case or deleted optional splitting-field parenthesis is used.
assertion.limit_order: Obtain f and full End=B first; conjugate the specified embeddings, then clear denominators. Same-L descent, compatibility, cocycles, Q-descent and quantitative bounds are separate.

use.reason: Obtain f and full End=B first; conjugate the specified embeddings, then clear denominators. Same-L descent, compatibility, cocycles, Q-descent and quantitative bounds are separate.
